title: Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences (DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures)
description: Sets the documented policy value DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent to 1. Windows stops showing consumer content: app suggestions, Windows Tips and third-party suggestions. Known side effect: extra Store apps stop being installed automatically. The previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
